turns.speaker: builder
turns.question: Do launch notifications need to use email copy or the SMS wording?

response.text: Use SMS copy. The required label is `Text alert: <product> launches at <time>`, and the implementation must preserve the UTC input time. Requirement id: nova-launch-sms-v1.

turns.speaker: builder
turns.question: Should the formatter derive the product name and UTC time from the event input?

response.text: Yes. Keep productName and launchAtUtc dynamic.
